shared_prefix_batch_finding.source: llama.cpp620d2225 tools/server/server-context.cpp checkpoint_offsets and near_prompt_end before llama_decode
shared_prefix_batch_finding.inference: Prompt-end checkpoint offsets are4+n_ubatch and4. With an approximately2K-token divergent suffix, physicalbatch2048 puts an earlier checkpoint in the sharedprefix while batch1024 places the endpoint checkpoint after branchdivergence. Consistent with observed reuse, workloaddependent; not a general coldprefill9x improvement.

follow_up_source_audit.mtp_gap: CPU pending_h/verify_h/row bookkeeping are outside saved target/draft KV and MTP implements no generic speculative-state payload. Restored draft processing can consume carryover from another conversation.
required_design: explicit predecessor positions and accepted-row mapping
prefix rewind and forced last-token replay reconstruction
follow_up_source_audit.required_tests: Production state transitions: uninterrupted A versus A/B/restore-A at the same actual position; malformed/old payloads; multiple slots and checkpoints; real-model acceptance and target output observations. A final-row serializer alone is incomplete.
follow_up_source_audit.failed_restore_gap: Successful target restore clears cached main bytes before draft restore. Draft failure leaves a selectable damaged entry; preserve all payloads until complete success, reject empty main state and evict failed entries.
follow_up_source_audit.classification: Read-only source consistency findings; no measured acceptance-rate or answer-quality loss and no partial fix shipped.

limitations: Finite greedy-output and serialized-state agreement does not prove quality equivalence for all inputs.
Initial cold throughput screens have one sample per depth.
5090 model payload differs from 4090/3090V; cross-GPU results describe deployed configurations.
No production optimization image deployed by these experiments.
Sustained swap pressure, multi-GPU, other hardware platforms and video are not performance-qualified here.
